statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-126190 (GHSA-mmhr-3c5m-f64f): before Soup Sieve 4.0, matching a selector with descendant combinators walks the same ancestors repeatedly, so select(), select_one() or the Beautiful Soup CSS APIs on deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML can keep a worker busy for seconds or minutes. It is fixed in Soup Sieve 4.0 by commit ff1a5ce (https://github.com/facelessuser/soupsieve/security/advisories/GHSA-mmhr-3c5m-f64f, https://github.com/facelessuser/soupsieve/commit/ff1a5ce7e5addc31626d7b6053511fecdb4f6320, https://github.com/facelessuser/soupsieve/releases/tag/4.0). We listed every file of all 98 published airflow packages in the DHI Debian repository, 3.3.0-0 through the current 3.4.0-8, for amd64 and arm64 (no debug-symbol packages are published for this source), including the files inside the wheels they bundle, and read each library's version from its dist-info directory under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages; both architectures agree for every build. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-0 contain no Soup Sieve: there is no soupsieve dist-info and no soupsieve package directory, and no bundled wheel holds one. Builds 3.4.0-1 to the current 3.4.0-8 ship soupsieve 3.0.4 in site-packages, used by the Beautiful Soup 4.15.0 they also ship. No published build ships Soup Sieve 4.0 or later, so the affected range starts at 3.4.0-1, the first build that ships Soup Sieve.
